title: Node.js readline chat
prompt: Build a Node.js readline chat with libfx. Keep one agent for the conversation, stream text to stdout, and close it on exit. Use the files below as a starting point.

title: Browser agent
prompt: Build a browser agent with libfx and WebAssembly using plain HTML without CSS. Use the free-token proxy by default. Let visitors enter an AI Gateway API key to connect directly, without sending their key to the proxy or saving it. Start a new conversation when the key changes. Use the files below as a starting point.

title: Next.js App Router
